identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a superior AI-enhanced penetration testing platform.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cyberpunk aesthetics with Swiss Grid precision.
Emotion First: Evoke a sense of control and power.
Content is King: Data density without clutter.
Zoom In: Focus on critical alerts and metrics.
Negative Space: Use black space to frame data.
Contrast: High contrast for alerts (Red/Orange) against deep black.

design_system.theme_strategy: Dark Mode Default (The Performance Pro Archetype)

spacing.strategy: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) for containers, tight gaps (gap-2, gap-4) for data grids.

modules.sidebar: col-span-2 hidden lg:block h-screen sticky top-0 border-r border-border/40

surface_styles.terminal: bg-[#050505] border border-border/20 font-mono text-sm text-green-500 p-4 relative overflow-hidden
surface_styles.glass_header: bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border/40 sticky top-0 z-50

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-all
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-sm

inputs.default: bg-background border-input ring-offset-background placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring rounded-none

cards.metric: p-6 flex flex-col justify-between border-l-2 border-l-primary/50 bg-card/20 hover:bg-card/40 transition-colors

navigation.sidebar_item: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-sm hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground transition-colors

visual_enhancers.scanlines: Overlay 'pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[linear-gradient(rgba(18,16,16,0)_50%,rgba(0,0,0,0.25)_50%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,0,0,0.06),rgba(0,255,0,0.02),rgba(0,0,255,0.06))] bg-[length:100%_2px,3px_100%] bg-repeat' for terminal sections.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle drop-shadows on active elements: 'drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,59,48,0.5)]' for alerts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for the main dashboard.
Use the 'Grid Borders' surface strategy for all cards (1px border, no shadow, sharp corners).
Ensure the 'Terminal' component has the 'Retro-Futurism' look (dark bg, monospace, scanlines).
Use 'Outfit' font for headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for all code/terminal text.
Prioritize the Dark Mode theme. Light mode should be functional but secondary.
Use 'Recharts' for all data visualization (Vulnerability scans, Network traffic).
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or the 'Grid Lines' pattern.
Keep animations minimal and fast (0.2s ease-out).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic centered layouts, gradients).
Create depth through z-index and subtle borders, not heavy shadows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Export components as named exports, pages as default exports.
